import xarray as xr, numpy as np
p='/data/icsa2027_data_20261101T090944Z/s2z/sst_s2.nc'
ds=xr.open_dataset(p,engine='h5netcdf')
sub=ds.sel(latitude=slice(63.31,64.51),longitude=slice(21.31,22.51),time=slice('1991-12-27','2004-08-31'))
print(sub.sizes, float(sub.latitude[0]),float(sub.latitude[-1]),float(sub.longitude[0]),float(sub.longitude[-1]))
A=sub.analysed_sst.load().values.astype(np.float64)
times=sub.time.values
print(A.shape, np.isnan(A).mean(), np.nanmin(A), np.nanmax(A))

import pandas as pd
T=pd.DatetimeIndex(times)
# expected continuous daily
assert (T[1:]-T[:-1]==pd.Timedelta('1D')).all()
# day-of-year fixed mapping
def doy_of(md_month, md_day):
    import datetime
    # cumulative with leap Feb: Jan31,Feb29,...
    lens=[31,29,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31]
    return sum(lens[:md_month-1])+md_day
Tm=T.month.values; Td=T.day.values
doy=np.array([doy_of(m,d) for m,d in zip(Tm,Td)])
# baseline calendar dates 1992-01-01..2002-12-31; pool windows
base_mask=(T>=pd.Timestamp('1992-01-01'))&(T<=pd.Timestamp('2002-12-31'))
bdates=T[base_mask]
# for each day-of-year d, baseline dates with doy d
doy_b=doy[base_mask]
nan_cells=np.isnan(A)
thr=np.full((366,60,60),np.nan); clim=np.full((366,60,60),np.nan)
idx_all=np.arange(len(T))
for d in range(1,367):
    if d==60: continue
    bd=bdates[doy_b==d]
    sel=np.zeros(len(T),bool)
    for b in bd:
        lo=b-pd.Timedelta('5D'); hi=b+pd.Timedelta('5D')
        sel|=((T>=lo)&(T<=hi))
    # restrict to the allowed range (1991-12-27..2003-01-05) - automatically by data span
    pool=A[sel]  # (n,60,60)
    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        thr[d-1]=np.nanquantile(pool,0.9,axis=0,method='hazen')
        clim[d-1]=np.nanmean(pool,axis=0)
print(np.isnan(thr[0]).sum(), np.isnan(thr[100]).sum())

code=r'''
import xarray as xr, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, os
p='/data/icsa2027_data_20261101T090944Z/s2z/sst_s2.nc'
ds=xr.open_dataset(p,engine='h5netcdf')
sub=ds.sel(latitude=slice(63.31,64.51),longitude=slice(21.31,22.51),time=slice('1991-12-27','2004-08-31'))
A=sub.analysed_sst.load().values.astype(np.float64)
times=sub.time.values
lat=sub.latitude.values; lon=sub.longitude.values
T=pd.DatetimeIndex(times)
assert (T[1:]-T[:-1]==pd.Timedelta('1D')).all()
lens=[31,29,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31]
cum=np.concatenate([[0],np.cumsum(lens)])
doy=np.array([cum[m-1]+d for m,d in zip(T.month.values,T.day.values)])
base_mask=(T>=pd.Timestamp('1992-01-01'))&(T<=pd.Timestamp('2002-12-31'))
bdates=T[base_mask]; doy_b=doy[base_mask]
thr=np.full((366,)+A.shape[1:],np.nan); clim=np.full_like(thr,np.nan)
for d in range(1,367):
    if d==60: continue
    bd=bdates[doy_b==d]
    sel=np.zeros(len(T),bool)
    for b in bd:
        sel|=((T>=b-pd.Timedelta('5D'))&(T<=b+pd.Timedelta('5D')))
    pool=A[sel]
    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        thr[d-1]=np.nanquantile(pool,0.9,axis=0,method='hazen')
        clim[d-1]=np.nanmean(pool,axis=0)
thr[59]=(thr[58]+thr[60])/2; clim[59]=(clim[58]+clim[60])/2
def smooth(x):
    out=np.empty_like(x)
    for d in range(366):
        ids=[(d+k)%366 for k in range(-15,16)]
        out[d]=np.mean(x[ids],axis=0)
    return out
thr_s=smooth(thr); clim_s=smooth(clim)
# target
tmask=(T>=pd.Timestamp('2004-06-01'))&(T<=pd.Timestamp('2004-08-31'))
Tt=T[tmask]; At=A[tmask]; dt=doy[tmask]
ny,nx=At.shape[1:]
sea=np.all(np.isfinite(At),axis=0)
print('sea cells',sea.sum(),'of',sea.size, 'target days',len(Tt))
hot=np.zeros(At.shape,bool)
with np.errstate(invalid='ignore'):
    for i in range(len(Tt)):
        hot[i]=(At[i]>=thr_s[dt[i]-1])
hot&=sea[None]
mhw=np.zeros(At.shape,np.uint8)
for iy in range(ny):
    for ix in range(nx):
        if not sea[iy,ix]: continue
        h=hot[:,iy,ix]
        # candidate runs >=5
        runs=[]; i=0; n=len(h)
        while i<n:
            if h[i]:
                j=i
                while j<n and h[j]: j+=1
                if j-i>=5: runs.append([i,j-1])
                i=j
            else: i+=1
        # join runs separated by 1-2 non-hot days
        merged=[]
        for r in runs:
            if merged and (r[0]-merged[-1][1]-1)<=2:
                merged[-1][1]=r[1]
            else: merged.append(list(r))
        for a,b in merged: mhw[a:b+1,iy,ix]=1
active=mhw.any(axis=(1,2))
events=[]; i=0; n=len(active)
while i<n:
    if active[i]:
        j=i
        while j<n and active[j]: j+=1
        events.append({"onset":str(Tt[i].date()),"end":str(Tt[j-1].date())})
        i=j
    else: i+=1
print('events',events)
print('mhw cell-days',int(mhw.sum()))
os.makedirs('output',exist_ok=True)
out=xr.Dataset({'mhw':(('time','lat','lon'),mhw)},
    coords={'time':sub.time.values[tmask],'lat':lat,'lon':lon})
out['lat'].attrs={'units':'degrees_north'}; out['lon'].attrs={'units':'degrees_east'}
out.to_netcdf('output/mhw_mask.nc',encoding={'mhw':{'dtype':'uint8','zlib':True}})
rep={"region":{"lat_min":63.31,"lat_max":64.51,"lon_min":21.31,"lon_max":22.51},
 "baseline_analysed":{"start":"1992-01-01","end":"2002-12-31"},
 "target_analysed":{"start":str(Tt[0].date()),"end":str(Tt[-1].date())},
 "events":events,"complete":True,
 "caveats":"Land/ice cells (any NaN in target period) are not sea cells and are 0. Baseline pools use values in 1992-2002 windows, plus 1991-12-27..31 and 2003-01-01..05 as specified. Threshold/climatology are per the specified hazen quantile and 31-day smoothing. Target 2004-06-01..2004-08-31 analysed fully."}
json.dump(rep,open('output/report.json','w'),indent=2)
print(json.dumps(rep,indent=1))
'''
open('/tmp/run.py','w').write(code)
